item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: DocumentDB on Azure Local
item.description:
Azure Local now has a public preview of DocumentDB, enabling MongoDB-compatible document workloads to run on customer-managed infrastructure. This is intended for scenarios where applications and data need to stay close together for latency or data-location requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates
